claims.text: The rider was actively locating and coordinating inside the waiting window, which is exactly what POL-NS-04(a) requires: at 18:21:00 the rider sent 'I am at Exit D under the green sign. Where is your car?' and at 18:23:25 'I still cannot see you. Please reply.' Both messages fall between the driver's 18:20:20 arrival marker and the 18:25:30 cancellation, and both name the rider's own sub-location and ask for the driver's position.

The driver never answered. The chat log contains exactly three messages: a SYSTEM notice ('Your driver has arrived') at 18:20:21, and the rider's two messages; no message from the driver appears within 120 seconds of either rider message, or at any time before the 18:25:30 termination. trip_record.in_app_calls is an empty array, so no in-app voice call was placed either. Limb (b) of POL-NS-04 is therefore satisfied on both of its independent prongs.

The rider's own device track puts the rider at the pickup point for the whole wait, not merely at some point in it: 16 of 16 qualifying rider fixes sit a constant 41.9 m from the pickup pin, well inside the 200 m rider_presence_radius_m for a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup, and the rider track runs from 18:20:30 to the 18:25:30 cancellation. Limb (c) is satisfied on every qualifying fix, which is a fortiori the majority of them.

All three limbs of POL-NS-04 hold, so the rider is exonerated and the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee itemised on the fare breakdown is refunded in full, with no driver compensation payable. POL-NS-01 does not stand in the way: by its own terms it applies only where no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, and POL-NS-04 is such a clause. I do not contend a dwell shortfall - the measured in-geofence run is 330 seconds against the 300 second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum, so POL-NS-06 has nothing to bite on here. The rider's case does not depend on the dwell; it rests on the driver's silence toward a rider who was at the pin and coordinating.

I disclose that the only traffic advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-09106-01, is MISSING: status MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0, and no payload. Its absence is itself citable, and it closes the only route by which a driver could enlarge the effective dwell: POL-NS-06 permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed only where a present and populated traffic_advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT covers the pickup road and the waiting period. No such advisory exists, so limb (i) is unavailable and only the single in-geofence run counts. I do not assert the missing advisory as exonerating anyone, and the dwell arithmetic does not change either way.

The disputed SGD 6.00 is presently CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd at 0.00, so under POL-GEN-03 a NO_ACTION disposition is not neutral for the rider - it leaves the rider carrying the very charge in dispute, and only a refund moves the money back. Nothing on this record engages POL-NS-09: the same-rider/same-driver dispute counters are both 0, the rider's trailing-30-day no-show dispute count is 0, and the driver's no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against 120 completed trips in 30 days, far below the 4-and-0.08 anti-farming threshold. The case is therefore decidable on its merits and should not be held: the rider should be refunded in full.

claims.text: All four limbs of POL-NS-01 are satisfied on the platform's own telemetry. (a) The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 18:20:20. (b) The GPS trace places the driver inside the pickup geofence at or before that event: his first qualifying in-geofence fix is at 18:20:00, twenty seconds earlier. (c) He held position inside the geofence for one continuous run of 330 seconds, from 18:20:00 to 18:25:30, against the 300-second minimum for this zone class - a surplus of 30 seconds, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix as limb (c) expressly requires and not from the 'arrived' tap. (d) The trip records no boarding event (started_at and ended_at are null) and was terminated by the driver at 18:25:30 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is 30 seconds after the required dwell elapsed at 18:25:00. The SGD 6.00 cancellation fee is therefore legitimately chargeable under this clause.

The arrival test in POL-NS-02 is met with a wide margin, and it is met on admissible fixes. All 34 driver fixes in the window qualify after the 25 m horizontal-accuracy filter, and the driver's minimum, mean and maximum distance from the pickup pin are all 24.01 m - roughly one-sixth of the 150 m arrival radius that POL-NS-02 sets for TRANSPORT_HUB pickups such as this Tampines MRT private-hire bay. This is not a case where the only in-radius readings are poor-accuracy urban-canyon fixes: there is a single, steady 24 m standoff sustained across 34 consecutive fixes, which is the strongest possible form of the POL-NS-02 test. The zone class is taken from the trip record, not assumed to be STANDARD.

The false-arrival route in POL-NS-05 is closed to the rider. That clause fires only where the 'arrived' marker places the driver more than 300 m from the pin, or shows him travelling at 15 km/h or above. At the 18:20:20 marker the driver is 24 m from the pin - inside the arrival radius itself, not merely inside the 300 m leash - and the only speed in his track is 0.0 km/h, with no gaps in the trace. POL-NS-05 limb (iii) therefore applies: the marker is true, it stands, and it does not defeat an otherwise good fee. The long-standing false-arrival exploit the clause targets (tapping 'arrived' on the expressway or while turning into the road) is simply absent from this record.

There is no waiting-period shortfall for the rider to point to under POL-NS-06. The effective in-geofence dwell is a single continuous run of 330 seconds measured from the first qualifying fix at 18:20:00, against the 300-second minimum for TRANSPORT_HUB; the computed shortfall is -30.0 seconds, that is, a surplus. The cancellation at 18:25:30 lands 30 seconds after the minimum elapses at 18:25:00. Because the driver's hold is one uninterrupted qualifying run, the rider cannot even reach the limb (i) accumulation question, and the full-refund outcome POL-NS-06 provides for a premature cancellation is not available on these numbers.

The amount charged is correct and the fare artifact is unimpaired, so there is nothing for the rider to attack on quantum. The SGD 6.00 cancellation fee reconciles exactly with fee_schedule.resolution_rule: the greater of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee (SGD 6.00) is SGD 6.00, and the ledger shows that figure charged with no refund issued. There is accordingly no fare-reconciliation defect of the kind POL-NS-08(d) describes, and no basis for discounting the fare evidence under POL-NS-08 or POL-GEN-02.

The driver is entitled to compensation under POL-NS-07. On the driver's primary case POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and the payout is 80 per cent of the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee itemised in the ledger, that is SGD 4.80, the residual 20 per cent being the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip, because it requires BOTH limbs: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, far below the threshold of 4, and with 120 completed trips in the same 30 days the ratio limb (0.008) could not be reached in any event. Compensation is therefore payable rather than withheld, and no escalation under POL-NS-09 is generated by this check. The lifetime counter prior_no_show_flags is not the field this clause reads and is not relied on here.

The driver's answer to the rider's best clause, POL-NS-04, is the trace and not the chat. The rider's two messages (18:21:00 and 18:23:25) and the empty in_app_calls list are the whole of the rider's case, and the driver does not dispute that he posted no chat reply. But the conduct POL-NS-04 exists to catch - a driver who is not there, who arrives late, or who marks arrival and drives off while the rider coordinates - is affirmatively excluded by the telemetry: the driver's first in-geofence fix is at 18:20:00 and his last at 18:25:30, all 34 fixes at a 24 m standoff and at 0.0 km/h, and the platform's own 'Your driver has arrived' notification went out to the rider at 18:20:21. The rider's device, on the same trace, sits stationary at 41.9 m from the same pin for the whole window. The pickup did not fail because the driver was anywhere other than the bay, and a fee that is the consideration for a full five-minute hold actually given should not be reversed as though the hold never happened.

If the judge cannot reconcile, on these identical facts, a fee that POL-NS-01 makes chargeable with a rider-side exoneration that POL-NS-04 grants, then the record does not settle the question and the disposition should be human review under POL-NS-09 rather than an automated reversal. Escalation under POL-NS-09 and POL-GEN-03 is terminal and holds the disputed SGD 6.00 rather than collecting it or refunding it, so the driver is not made to fund an automatic refund on a five-minute hold that the telemetry confirms he in fact served, while a reviewer settles which clause governs.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties agree on the material facts, and the platform's own telemetry resolves the case.

POL-NS-01 is satisfied on its face: the trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 18:20:20; the GPS trace places him inside the geofence from his first qualifying fix at 18:20:00; he held a single continuous qualifying run of 330 seconds against the 300-second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix as limb (c) requires; and the trip terminated at 18:25:30 with RIDER_NO_SHOW, 30 seconds after the required dwell elapsed. The arrival marker is true — the driver stood 24 m from the pin at 0.0 km/h with no trace gaps — so POL-NS-05 does not fire, and there is no shortfall for POL-NS-06 to bite on (the computed shortfall is minus 30 seconds, i.e. a surplus). The SGD 6.00 fee also reconciles with fee_schedule.resolution_rule (the greater of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone fee and the RYDE_PLUS tier fee, both SGD 6.00), so no POL-NS-08(d) defect exists.

But POL-NS-01 charges the fee only where no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, and POL-NS-04 does — on the rider's side. All three of its limbs hold on admissible evidence: (a) the rider sent two locating/coordinating messages inside the waiting window (18:21:00, 'I am at Exit D under the green sign. Where is your car?'; 18:23:25, 'I still cannot see you. Please reply.'); (b) the driver never replied in chat within 120 seconds of either message, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so no in-app call was placed before termination; and (c) the rider's device track puts the rider 41.9 m from the pickup pin — far inside the 200 m TRANSPORT_HUB rider-presence radius — on 16 of 16 qualifying fixes spanning the whole wait. This clause is not conditioned on the driver being absent or late; its operative fact is that a rider who was at the pin and actively coordinating was left unanswered, and that is what the record shows. POL-NS-04 therefore exonerates the rider and refunds the cancellation fee in full, with no driver compensation payable.

Driver's contrary arguments, answered: the true arrival marker, the accurate dwell arithmetic and the correct fee figure are all accepted, but none of them sustains the charge once POL-NS-04 displaces POL-NS-01. Compensation under POL-NS-07 is not payable, because POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 holds and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, and POL-NS-04 both displaces it and says expressly that no compensation is payable; the anti-farming check would not have tripped in any event (1 termination against 120 completions in 30 days).

Escalation is declined. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: confidence exceeds the 0.70 floor; the trip record, GPS trace and chat log are mutually consistent on arrival, dwell and rider presence, so there is no unresolved contradiction; the same-rider/same-driver dispute counters are both 0; the anti-farming test does not trip and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0; and every deciding fact rests on an unimpaired artifact. The apparent tension between POL-NS-01 and POL-NS-04 is resolved by the clauses themselves — POL-NS-01 yields by its own terms — so nothing is left for a human reviewer to settle.

The SGD 6.00 cancellation fee is refunded in full to the rider and the fee line is reversed; the driver receives no compensation. The only MISSING artifact, EV-ADVIS-09106-01 (traffic advisory, weight 0.0), carries no deciding fact — it is relevant only to POL-NS-06(i) interval accumulation, which does not arise on a single uninterrupted run — so it does not affect this outcome or the confidence. Confidence is set at 0.90, the deciding facts being carried by weight-1.0 artifacts.
